definitions.gloss: night owl; night person; someone who is more active at night
definitions.explanation: Describes a person whose natural rhythm or lifestyle tends toward being active late at night. The opposite is 朝型 (morning person).

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{夜型|よるがた}だ。
{夜型|よるがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I've been keeping a night-owl lifestyle.

examples.japanese: {夜型|よるがた}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{朝型|あさがた}→朝型：16867_asagata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Switching from being a night owl to a morning person is not easy.

notes:
Describes a person or lifestyle pattern oriented toward nighttime activity. Formed from ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧ (night) + {型|がた} (type/pattern).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜型|よるがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: night person
- {夜型|よるがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: night-owl lifestyle
- {夜型|よるがた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a night owl
- {夜型|よるがた}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{朝型|あさがた}→朝型：16867_asagata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change from night owl to morning person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朝型|あさがた}→朝型：16867_asagata⟧: morning person — the opposite pattern, someone who rises early and is most productive in the morning
- ⟦{夜更|よふ}かし→夜更かし：07693_yofukashi⟧: staying up late — refers to the act of staying up rather than a lifestyle type
